title: Dead artefacts held in place by code or an open ruling, and stale comments a doc sweep cannot reach
body:
From cc's lane; each needs hv:

- `lib/templates/hooks/module_check_hook.json`: nothing reads it, but a roster row in `exit_code_consumers.rs:128` names it.
- `lib/templates/hooks/critic-guard.sh` is parked and has drifted: it lacks 0242's zero-scope report. Retire it, or re-roster it after porting that report.
- The `rules/_schema/index-generator.md`, `rules/index.json` and `.template` trio sit behind the unwired `claude rules index`, whose retirement is pending hv. `index.json` is also wrong.
- `lib/templates/llm/{_ARCHETYPES,_DECISION_TREE,_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH,_MODULES}.md` and `lib/templates/prj/st/ST####/{acceptance,design,impl,tasks}.md` are dead, and still embedded through `init.rs` DESTINATIONS rows. Deleting them is code.
- Stale comments in test and code files, listed in `817fa950b`: hv-banned counts in bats and Rust test headers; `guard_dispatch.bats:41` says pre-commit.sh is copied; `schema_faces_drift.rs:6,39` name a test target that is now a module of `suite`; `rules_path_guard.bats:20-21` grep paths that are gone, so they pass vacuously; organize.rs, tui.rs, mcp_stdio.rs, plugins.rs and the Cargo.toml descriptions.
- `intent/plugins/claude/subagents/.manifest/global-agents.json` (ic): no v3 code reads it, it has drifted, and its checksums are empty. Three bats tests assert it (critic_prose, rule_pack_shell, highlander_audit), so deleting it removes their assertions.

Line numbers as at the audit.

Found by hv's estate-wide doc audit of 2026-09-11 (the audit's orders are in `intent/history/20260911-doc-audit.md`), where it is described as built. Carried in `intent/wip.md` as an unruled defect until 2026-09-13, when that file was leaned and every open defect became an issue. Not worked until hv rules it; a ruled one gets a lane.

**CLOSED 2026-09-16, landed on vc's word in two parts.** (a) at d843f7aea: every dead artefact is deleted with everything that names it, as hv ruled on 2026-09-15 (item 3) -- the module-check and critic-guard hook templates, the rules-index trio with `claude rules index` retired from the register, the dead llm and prj templates with their init rows, and global-agents.json with the bats assertions that read it -- and the stale comments routed to cc's lane say what is true. (b) in the commit that closes this issue: the counts sweep over test files' leading comments, under vc's rule that a figure stays only when the number is the design decision; the measurements the headers no longer carry are in that commit's message.
